name: Reaction
purpose: A short on-camera reaction loops while changing text or numbers recontextualize an on-screen hook question and the apparent meaning of that same reaction.
user_description: I'm shaking doing a progressive reaction to a string or number changing the context of the text hook question.

structure.instruction: Establish the readable on-screen question and its initial context.
Present the specified sequence of text or numeric states. Each state must change how the hook question is understood or answered.

Repeat the short reaction across the changing context states. The meaning progresses through the text or number changes; a new performed reaction is not required at each state. Nodding yes and shaking the head no are common, not mandatory.
Make the final text state understandable alongside the repeated reaction. Choose the overall video ending separately from the short reaction loop; no automatic CTA.

reaction_loop.guidance: Approximate loop length, not a strict duration or a text-change interval. Select natural loop boundaries from the performance.
reaction_loop.motion: user-selected; yes/no head movement is optional

beat_model.note: Context beats reference a shared reaction loop. Text hold timing is independent of the approximately half-second video loop.

review_checks: Does the changing text or number recontextualize the question and repeated reaction?
Is each context state readable for long enough, independent of the loop interval?
Does the short reaction repeat cleanly without distracting visual jumps?
Is nodding/head shaking optional rather than forced?
Are looped source audio and the chosen soundtrack handled deliberately?
open_decisions: Obtain one actual hook question and sequence of values
Choose the reaction motion and usable source loop
Number of context beats and their timing
Whether the question stays fixed or also changes
Source audio handling, speech and any speech captions
Music selection from a curated list once actual tracks exist
note: The reaction is a repeated short performance, not a succession of newly performed reactions. Approximately 0.5 seconds describes the reaction loop, not each text hold or the whole video.
user_clarification: The person performs a roughly 0.5-second reaction that loops. Often, but not always, this is nodding yes or shaking their head no.
